scenes.narration_text: Gradient Descent is a fundamental optimization algorithm.
scenes.visual_description: Loss function parabola and title display

scenes.narration_text: We iteratively update parameters in the direction of steepest descent.
scenes.visual_description: Point moving down the parabola curve towards zero

scenes.narration_text: When the gradient approaches zero, the algorithm converges.
scenes.visual_description: Point stabilizes at the global minimum
